title: Infiltrator removed before the 1997 congressional briefing

tellings.quote: Look, the 1997 briefings we did for Congress off off site at the Western Hotel, we had somebody made it very far into that process.

plain: Before the 1997 UFO briefings he organized for members of Congress at a Washington hotel, Steven Greer says, an infiltrator made it "very far into that process" before being removed. Greer, who ran the briefings, tells Michels this first-hand, and names the Apollo astronaut Edgar Mitchell and Congressman Dan Burton in telling it. If true, it would mean someone was trying to watch or steer the effort from inside.
